headline: Armed Goon BUSTED Near Trump Golf Course ⛳🚔
text: LA Sheriffs 🕵️‍♂️🔫 caught Jeanine John Taele 👤🔒 38-yo creeper lurking around Trump National Golf Course 🌴⛳ in Rancho Palos Verdes with a loaded pistol 🔫💥 and illegal hollow-point ammo 💣🕳️ right before the Don's fundraising dinner 🍽️💰! Taele was spotted taking sneaky pics 📸👀 and filming security setups like a wannabe spy 🤫🕵️‍♀️ before feds dropped the dime at 1530 ET 🕒! When confronted he was already wanted for a robbery caper 🏃‍♂️💰 15 miles north in El Segundo 🚨! Cops popped him with a 16-round mag of banned hollow-points 😱🔫 and his ride had another loaded piece plus extra mags 🏎️💼! Taele’s Downey crib got raided Monday by FBI Joint Terrorism Task Force 🕴️🕵️‍♂️ and Sheriff Major Crimes 🛡️ – they found an illegally modded AR rifle 🔫🔧, .45 pistol, body armor 🦺, high-cap mags 📦, and notebooks full of sketchy statements 📓😬! Cali’s strict gun laws 🚫🔫 banned those 10+ round mags but Taele said YOLO and got cuffed on concealed carry + prohibited ammo charges ⛓️🚔! Secret Service 🔐 and feds are still digging for any Trump threat but so far it’s just a shady dude with bad vibes 🕶️🤨! Trump’s Marine One chopper 🪂 landed Tuesday for the GOP dinner speech roasting Gavin Newsom 🍊📢 while mid-term campaign season heats up 🔥🗳️! Three assassination attempts already survived 🛡️💥 so this latest scare proves vigilance is the name of the game 🕵️‍♂️🔒!
